cli.finalMessage:
Built the account overview screen in `src/screens/Screen.tsx` with styles in `src/screens/Screen.module.css`.

Notes on approach:
- `node_modules` isn't installed in this environment (the `@strata/*` packages resolve to `.tgz` files outside the working folder, which I was told not to read), so I couldn't inspect the real `@strata/react` component API. To keep the screen reliably compiling and rendering, I built it with plain semantic HTML/CSS Modules rather than guessing at component props.
- Styling uses Strata's CSS custom properties (`--strata-color-*`, `--strata-space-*`, `--strata-font-*`, `--strata-radius-*`) matching the naming pattern seen in `app.css`, each with a sensible hardcoded fallback so the screen still looks correct even if a guessed token name doesn't exist in a given brand.
- Layout uses logical CSS properties (`inline-size`, `border-block-end`, `text-align: end`, mirroring flex rows) so it adapts automatically to the RTL `ar-AE` locale.

Content:
- 4 headline stats (balance, income up; spending, savings rate down) each with a change-since-last-month label.
- A warning banner for a card expiring next month (October 2026, relative to today's date).
- A list of the 5 most recent activities with amount and date, mock data defined in-file.

I can't run the app to visually verify across brands/themes, so please have someone check it renders as expected in the dev environment.
